ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro distribution characterized by a predominant high-intensity (white) central field (approx. 90% of visible surface) bounded by a low-intensity (black) perimeter along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric block across both lobes; a continuous non-linear black band mapped to the trailing edge; a singular high-contrast black focal spot at the interior base of the fluke near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 70-80 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations throughout the continuous boundary; multiple irregular pixel-level peaks and valleys creating a jagged contour isolated from the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave curve fitted from the distal tips toward the median notch; outer trailing edges exhibit a symmetrical inward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruption on the outer third of the left lobe, extending from the mid-surface toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregularity at the apex of the median notch; singular small black circular lesion at the lower central fluke-water interface.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical pigmentation density at the distal tips, with the left tip exhibiting a broader low-intensity black region compared to the right.
